description: Fictional starter world: 8 original clubs, 40 players, 8 coaches. Names, appearances and art are invented; no real people, teams or brands.

teams.name: Northwind
teams.colors: deep navy and ice white with thin silver accents
teams.crest: a sharp four-pointed compass star cutting through a stylized gust of wind
teams.jersey: deep navy body, ice-white raglan shoulders, thin silver piping, faint diagonal wind-streak pattern across the torso

teams.name: Red Kite
teams.crest: the angular head of a kite bird of prey in profile, built from sharp geometric facets
teams.jersey: crimson red body with a bold matte-black diagonal band from right shoulder to left hip, black collar

teams.name: Iron Vale
teams.crest: an anvil silhouette set inside a mountain valley shape, heavy industrial lines
teams.jersey: charcoal grey body with burnt-orange stacked chevrons on the chest and sleeves, orange V-collar

teams.name: Sunline
teams.crest: a half sun rising over a single horizon line, rays as sharp blades
teams.jersey: golden yellow body with forest-green sleeves and side panels, subtle wave pattern in the yellow

teams.name: Polar Arc
teams.colors: glacier blue and white with navy trim
teams.crest: a geometric polar bear head under a curved aurora arc
teams.jersey: glacier-blue body with faint hexagon ice texture, white shoulder yoke, navy collar and cuffs

teams.name: Obsidian Tide
teams.crest: a breaking wave carved from faceted black glass with a teal edge
teams.jersey: black body with a sharp electric-teal wave line sweeping across the chest, teal cuffs

teams.name: Hollow Crown
teams.crest: an open, hollow five-point crown outline with a small star at its center
teams.jersey: deep royal-purple body with antique-gold pinstripes and gold shoulder bands

teams.name: Atlas Union
teams.colors: white and cobalt blue with a red accent
teams.crest: a stylized globe with orbit rings forming a shield shape
teams.jersey: white body with cobalt-blue sleeves and a thin red stripe down each side, cobalt collar
